summary: Google DeepMind launched Gemini Robotics ER 2, an updated embodied-reasoning model that adds real-time video-based progress tracking, tool/task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration, available via the Gemini API, Google AI Studio, and in private preview on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.

mechanisms.reason: The model is stated to match larger model categories on moment-finding accuracy while using a fraction of the compute cost and running faster.
mechanisms.quote: It competes closely with much larger model categories, but delivers this precision at a fraction of the compute cost and 4x the execution speed—the sub-second latency actually required to safely operate physical robotics in the real world.

mechanisms.reason: The document describes a first demonstration of a new task class, multi-robot collaboration across heterogeneous robots.
mechanisms.quote: We are also introducing multi-robot collaboration, enabling robots to work together in shared spaces and complete complex workflows a single robot could not do alone.

practices.reason: Teams building physical-agent or robotics products get a model with stated gains in tool orchestration, video-based progress tracking, and safety behavior around humans.
practices.quote: Gemini Robotics ER 2 achieves 57.4% accuracy on progress classification tasks, outperforming previous generation models and competing frontier models.

practices.reason: The claimed compute-cost and speed advantage over larger models is a serving-efficiency result, but it is reported on the lab's own infrastructure and not handed over as a reproducible technique.
practices.quote: delivers this precision at a fraction of the compute cost and 4x the execution speed

practices.reason: New API and platform availability creates an integration surface for teams wanting to build physical AI agents but is not a breaking or mandatory change.
practices.quote: Gemini Robotics ER 2 is now publicly available to developers via the Gemini API , Google AI Studio , and in private preview on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform .
